description: Provenance for first-party crates vendored into leio-code. Enforced by the `vendored-crate-provenance` doctor under `leio-code audit --strict`. See docs/architecture/vendored-crate-provenance.md. No crates are vendored today: parser functionality is consumed from pre-built wheels under artifacts/wheels/.
hash_algorithm: sha256 over each regular file under the crate directory (excluding any `target` directory), sorted by forward-slash relative path, feeding `path || 0x00 || bytes || 0x00` per file
